items.headline: DeChambeau, Rahm Preparation
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm are expected to be better prepared for the US Open compared to other LIV players, addressing a major criticism of LIV Golf's readiness for majors.

items.headline: PGA Tour Field Thinness
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage as the PGA Tour Charles Schwab Challenge field at Colonial Country Club is weak, featuring only one OWGR top-10 player.
